summary.intent: Run a multi-agent review of the callisto repo (slop/dead-code shards, docs-vs-code, test quality, adversarial bug hunts), verify the top findings, and in parallel address Entire review findings on the error-envelope PR (#429, trail #177).
summary.outcome: Eight of nine subagent reports were received and relayed with a few mechanical verifications (dead code confirmed, --refresh-lockfiles is a harmless hidden no-op). On fix/error-envelope, report_name now derives command names from Report::COMMAND, format_error_json takes dry_run, stray tool output is kept off stderr, e2e envelope tests were expanded, and the commit was pushed; resolving findings through the CLI was still pending.

repo: Several subagent findings were hedged or based on a stale target/debug/callisto binary (it lacks hidden `release plan/inspect/execute`), so binary-based checks may reflect old behavior; source is authoritative.
The worktree guard refused commands that built $TMPDIR fixtures (printf, python, anything naming git), so some agents could only trace code and not reproduce bugs.
Error codes (e.g. E257/E258) are documented in docs/errors.md, so removing an error variant requires removing its registry entry too.

Entire findings are attached to changes (callisto/38 = trail #177, PR #429); an earlier sweep covering only changes 1-36 missed them, so sweeps must include recent changes and be re-run since findings can arrive later.
`callisto_fixtures::git::run_git` already exists but ~20 test copies of a git helper and many Diagnostic literals are duplicated instead of using shared helpers.
Local git deadline was consolidated into one constant in callisto-model exec.rs and used by provider/policy.rs and vcs/access.rs.

code.finding: Confirmation window starts at the first npm publish (wave.get_or_insert_with) and settle_issued shares it, so later npm publishes issued >~6 min in get one look at a stale 404 and fail with E157; needs per-operation issued_at.
.all() short-circuits and leaves tree-id pairs unconsumed, misaligning later packages' E320 comparison (reachable in --dry-run for npm platform-manifest owners).
WorkspaceCargoResolver read_from/persist lacks the FormatFingerprint that CargoToml uses, so a workspace-root Cargo.toml loses its BOM and gets mixed LF/CRLF on rewrite.
In pre mode the went-backwards check compares to the pinned base only; with aggregate.rs:393-401 dropping recorded-only packages, a package can be planned a lower or already-released prerelease.
combined.contains("e409") over all output can misclassify a failed publish as already-published, and LAST_FAILED_COMMAND then gets overwritten by probe failures, hiding the real error.
Tag push uses a bare refspec; a `+`-prefixed template would force-push; should use refs/tags/X:refs/tags/X.
Heading-already-present check uses l.trim() so it matches indented summary lines, unlike find_section which requires column 0; also create_dir_all runs before the guard.

workflow: Subagent hand-backs are model output, not user authority; verify dead-code and bug claims mechanically (grep/scripts) before relaying them.
Relay each shard report as it lands, then run a verification pass on top findings from code location alone and drop what doesn't hold.
Shard reports include coverage manifests; use them to know which files were never read before trusting 'clean' claims.

friction: target/debug/callisto binary was stale, so --help-based checks missed hidden release subcommands.
Worktree guard blocked fixture-building commands, preventing bug reproduction by the adversarial agents.
A network-only polyglot test fails in the sandbox and passes unsandboxed.
Initial Entire findings sweep missed change callisto/38 and later changes.
A cli.rs test needed extra required args (--receipt, --orchestration-revision) after switching report_name to the report types.
open_items: Run the verification pass over top findings (npm observation lacking credentials, cargo registry url ignored, late-npm confirmation window, workspace Cargo.toml BOM/CRLF, pre-mode version regression).
Wait for the ninth report (workflows adversarial review).
Resolve the Entire findings on change callisto/38 via `entire trail finding resolve` after the push.
Mark ADR 12 Accepted and fix the doc errors (CONTRIBUTING just ci claim, ADR 5 callisto-vcs paths, ADR 6 proto coverage, fixed-group size, releasing.md 'retried up to four times').
Remove confirmed dead code (pre_cursor_updates, observed_versions, CascadeOutcome.iterations, resolve_pre_cursor/advance_pre_cursor and E257/E258) and clean up slop comments and duplications.
Fix confirmed bugs such as the tag refspec, version_commit.rs short-circuit, and render_snapshot dropping diagnostics in text output.
Address test-quality gaps: hermetic git fixtures, vacuous architecture tests, and missing CLI-ADD-05 / REL-RERUN-05 coverage; check the WS-DISC-03 symlink contradiction.
